blurb: Guests paddle in replica ocean-going canoes while First Nation guides share songs, legends, and point out ancient village sites. Tours include cultural interpretation and traditional knowledge of the Tsleil-Waututh Nation. Activities also include SUP lessons, yoga, fitness classes, and walking tours combined with canoeing.
